dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge is predominantly linear and non-falcate, exhibiting a straight diagonal descent from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a very sharp termination and minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, measured at approximately 78 degrees relative to the horizontal basal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated profile with a maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height ratio of approximately 1:2.4.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct small circular hypopigmented mark located in the lower-medial region of the fin blade; irregular light mottling along the anterior basal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally tall and narrow triangular silhouette characteristic of high-aspect-ratio dorsal fins.
